title: Eucommia ulmoides (Duzhong) extract alleviates cerebral stroke by inhibiting ferroptosis-related gene DNA Damage-Inducible Transcript 4 (DDIT4) expression.
authors: Qi, Xin; Deng, Mengyuan; Li, Minhong; Ma, Wenjia; Zhou, Yangbo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究杜仲提取物通过抑制铁死亡相关基因DDIT4表达治疗脑卒中，属于疾病机制与药物研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cerebral stroke is an acute cerebrovascular disease, which is characterized by significant morbidity, death, and disability rate. Ischemic stroke is more than hemorrhagic stroke and accounts for 60-70% of all strokes. The present study explored the mechanisms of Eucommia ulmoides extract (EUE) in the treatment of ischemic stroke. Middle cerebral artery occlusion (MCAO) mouse models and oxygen and glucose deprivation (OGD) SH-SY5Y cell models were constructed to mimic ischemic stroke, and mice and cells were treated with gradient concentrations of EUE. The neurological function and brain tissue damage in mice were assessed using multiple parameters. Then the iron contents in cerebral tissue samples and neuronal cells were examined, and the expression levels of reactive oxygen species-related indicators and iron metabolism-related proteins were detected. EUE alleviated the ferroptosis process within cerebral tissue samples of MCAO mice and OGD-triggered neuronal cells, thereby mitigating neurological function and brain tissue damage by activating PI3K/Akt pathway. The target drug genes of EUE were searched by network pharmacology and molecular docking and found that the ferroptosis-related gene DDIT4 is the potential EUE-targeted gene in the therapy of ischemic stroke. DDIT4 expression was upregulated within cerebral brain samples of MCAO mice and OGD-triggered neuronal cells, and EUE could inhibit DDIT4 expression. The protective effect of EUE on neuronal cells could be partially reversed by overexpression of DDIT4. Moreover, EUE alleviated ferroptosis and improved neurological function in MCAO mice by suppressing DDIT4 expression and modulating the PI3K/Akt pathway. In conclusion, EUE exerts its neuroprotective effect against cerebral stroke by inhibiting DDIT4 expression and ferroptosis by regulating the PI3K/Akt pathway, and DDIT4 has been predicted to be an underlying therapeutic target for the treatment of ischemic stroke.
abstract_zh: 脑卒中是一种急性脑血管疾病，具有显著的高发病率、高死亡率和高致残率特点。缺血性脑卒中较出血性脑卒中更为常见，占所有脑卒中的60-70%。本研究探讨了杜仲提取物（EUE）治疗缺血性脑卒中的机制。构建了大脑中动脉闭塞（MCAO）小鼠模型和氧糖剥夺（OGD）SH-SY5Y细胞模型以模拟缺血性脑卒中，并用梯度浓度的EUE处理小鼠和细胞。通过多个参数评估小鼠的神经功能和脑组织损伤。随后检测了脑组织样本和神经元细胞中的铁含量，并检测了活性氧相关指标和铁代谢相关蛋白的表达水平。EUE减轻了MCAO小鼠脑组织样本和OGD诱导的神经元细胞中的铁死亡过程，从而通过激活PI3K/Akt通路改善神经功能和脑组织损伤。通过网络药理学和分子对接搜索EUE的靶向药物基因，发现铁死亡相关基因DDIT4是EUE在缺血性脑卒中治疗中的潜在靶基因。DDIT4在MCAO小鼠脑样本和OGD诱导的神经元细胞中表达上调，而EUE能抑制DDIT4表达。DDIT4的过表达可部分逆转EUE对神经元细胞的保护作用。此外，EUE通过抑制DDIT4表达和调节PI3K/Akt通路，减轻了MCAO小鼠的铁死亡并改善了神经功能。总之，EUE通过调控PI3K/Akt通路抑制DDIT4表达和铁死亡，从而发挥其对脑卒中的神经保护作用，且DDIT4被预测为治疗缺血性脑卒中的潜在治疗靶点。
